## Feature Summary

Give your proposed feature a clear and concise title.

## Problem Statement

Describe the problem or limitation this feature would solve.

## Proposed Solution

Explain how you would like the feature to work.

## Expected Benefits

Describe how this feature would improve StudentIQ.

## Proposed Implementation

If you have an idea about the implementation, describe it here.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions you have considered.

## Additional Context

Add screenshots, examples, references, or other relevant information.

## Contribution

- [ ] I am willing to contribute to implementing this feature.
- [ ] I can help with testing this feature.
- [ ] I need guidance before contributing.

**Privacy Reminder:** Do not share API keys, passwords, or personally identifiable student information.
